title: Kid Ory's band on the Cabaret Hall front porch
summary: Ory played trombone with Oliver on Monday nights on a hall's front porch, and Robinson remembers the trombonists then.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: They had home. I forgot the name. Did you ever hear, uh... Ori and Oliver play together down here? Who?
Ori and Oliver. Oh yeah, sure. Ori used to play a tram on... Uh, uh, uh, with King Oliver.
Uh, right when I checked that right there now on, uh, on, uh, Tremont Street.

Every, every Monday night with Kid Oliver. Uh, right when I checked that right there now on, uh, on, uh, Tremont Street. Every Monday night, Kiddawa would play every Monday night, you know. Kiddawa was playing trombone. They had a front porch. The front porch, the band would come out on the evening and the front porch, the dance start at 8 o'clock, the band would come on the porch around about 7.30, the front porch. Them guys, these are plebs on the music on that front porch.
At the church, it's the church then, huh? It's called the Cabaret Hall.
And that had a front porch, huh?

Yeah, it had a front porch. Sure. Yeah. And I always used to blow some trombone on that porch, man. I wasn't playing trombone then. I used to mind all the trombone playing that. stuff with Buddy Johnson, Harrison Bone, Vic Gaskett, man they had some good trombone players, yeah. They were good trombone players. Who played clarinet with Ori and Oliver? The time that Giza played there I think, who was playing with Oliver? I think it was Johnny Dodds, I think. I think it was Johnny Dodds, yeah.
